Ovrtone Key Commands

Version 0.4.0, beta. Every keyboard shortcut and mouse modifier in Ovrtone, by area. Ovrtone follows Logic Pro's key commands with Ctrl in place of Cmd and Alt in place of Option, and FL Studio's for the Piano Roll and Channel Rack.

Every key command in the main list can be changed: Settings > Keyboard. Help > Logic-style Key Commands… (Alt+K) shows the list as it is set now. A key command waits while you type in a text field; over the Piano Roll, the keys it uses itself go to it (see section 9).
1. Transport2. Recording3. Tracks4. Editing5. Navigation and zoom6. Windows and views7. Files and projects8. Mixing9. Piano Roll10. Typing Keyboard11. Mouse and modifiers12. Screensets

1. Transport

KeysDoes
SpacePlay or stop
EnterGo to the beginning
, / .Back or forward one bar
CCycle on or off (over the selected regions when there are any)
KMetronome on or off
Shift+KCount-in on or off
Tab / Shift+TabGo to the next or previous transient (audio)
Ctrl+Alt+BMap Beat to Playhead

9. Piano Roll

These work while the pointer is over the Piano Roll, as in FL Studio. Every other key command works there too.

KeysDoes
PDraw tool
BPaint tool
DDelete tool
TMute tool
CSlice tool
ESelect tool
ZZoom tool
YPlayback tool
SSlide: the selected notes slide (bend) from the note before them
Delete / BackspaceDelete the selected notes
Ctrl+ASelect all notes
Ctrl+D or EscDeselect (Esc also clears the time selection)
Shift+IInvert the selection
Shift+RSelect a random note
Shift+MSelect the notes not selected (as FL Studio)
Shift+CSelect the notes of the chosen colour group
Ctrl+C / X / VCopy, cut, paste notes
Ctrl+BDuplicate the selected notes after themselves
Ctrl+UChop the selected notes to the grid
Ctrl+GGlue the selected notes into one
Ctrl+LLegato: each note lasts to the next
Ctrl+QQuantize
Shift+QQuantize the starts only
Alt+M / Alt+Shift+MMute or unmute the selected notes
Alt+VGhost notes on or off (the other regions' notes)
↑ / ↓Selected notes up or down a semitone (Ctrl: an octave)
Shift+← / →Selected notes earlier or later by a grid step
← / →Move the view a bar
Page Up / Page DownZoom in or out
Right-drag the ruler, or Ctrl+dragTime selection (takes the notes in it)
Ctrl+Delete / Ctrl+InsertDelete or insert the time selection's space
Click or drag the rulerMove the playhead
Alt while drawing or draggingNo snap: the finest step

10. Typing Keyboard

With the Typing Keyboard on (Ctrl+K, or its button on the control bar), the computer keyboard plays notes on the selected track. While it is on, Shift picks the Piano Roll tools and the plain number keys play notes rather than recall screensets.

KeysPlays
Z X C V B N M , . /White keys from C, lower octave
S D G H J L ;Black keys, lower octave
Q W E R T Y U I O PWhite keys, an octave up
2 3 5 6 7 9 0Black keys, upper octave
Numpad + / -Octave up or down

11. Mouse and modifiers

DoDoes
Drag a region's edgeTrim it; the audio stays where it is in the song
Alt+drag an audio region's endTime-stretch it to the new length
Ctrl+Alt+drag inside an audio regionSlip: slide the audio inside the region, which stays put
Smart Tool: top half / bottom half / edges / top cornersSelect / move / trim / fade
Drag in the ruler's top row (bar numbers)Set the Cycle (loop) region; click it to turn Cycle on or off
Click or drag below the bar numbersMove the playhead
Drop a sample on the Tracks areaChoose what it becomes: hit, audio clip, Channel Rack channel, step pattern, Piano Roll channel, or this track's sound
Drop a sample in the Channel RackA new channel, on the Playlist at once (on a row: that channel's sound)
Channel Rack: press a step and drag along the rowPaint steps; right-drag erases
Flex Pitch: drag a note blob up or downMove that note by semitones; double-click resets it; right-click for formant and vibrato
Piano Roll lanes: left-drag / right-dragDraw / erase controller values
Right-click the control bar's mode buttonsChoose which mode buttons show (Typing Keyboard, Low Latency)
Right-click the count-in buttonPre-roll and post-roll
